title: Wendell and the Wolf
author: Ines Ishikawa
blurb: Mara Halloran, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
